{{Top|leg}}
'''Maintenance storage locker 13A1''' was located in [[docking bay 5662]] of the [[Laertos Spaceport]]. It was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as [[Drop Point: Laertos]] during [[Operation Nighthook]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Access was via using [[Keycard/Legends|keycard]] [[Alpha 13]] and inserting it into the second key slot from the bottom.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
